ana-laura-quiles.text: (2024) Helped lead the recall effort against trustees Nava and Ramirez after they fired the superintendent: "We hope Nava and Ramirez do the right thing and step down and avoid another cost to the school district, but if not, it will be recall in November."

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: 2 on Keppel board face recall (2024-01-19)

andrew-ramirez.text: (2023) As vice president, joined Nava and Ballante at a Dec. 28, 2023 special meeting in firing Superintendent Terry Walker without cause, days before SB 494's 72-hour notice rule took effect.

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Hundreds decry Keppel leader's ouster (2024-01-18)

andrew-ramirez.text: (2023) Cast the lone dissent (3-1) when the board appointed Terry Walker superintendent on July 11, 2023.

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Keppel chief meeting legally posted (2024-01-04)

andrew-ramirez.text: (2023) Voted with Nava against Walker's employment agreement, approved 3-2 on Aug. 15, 2023.

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Hundreds decry Keppel leader's ouster (2024-01-18)

andrew-ramirez.text: (2024) With Nava and Ballante, approved an 18-month interim contract for Priya Darbari in February and then a four-year superintendent contract ($220,000/yr) in April on a 3-2 vote.

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Keppel approves 4-year contract for superintendent (2024-04-04)

notes: Both candidates' records come from the 2023-24 Keppel superintendent-firing controversy (governance, no policy-dimension mapping): Ramirez in the board majority, Quiles leading the recall. No 2026 campaign statements, forums or endorsements found. Searches used: 8.
